scope: Fresh AC1021 single-LINE writer output and a same-converter positive control; checksum-resealed file-header-only differentials. Does not diagnose ODA rejection or qualify complete writing.

authority.spec: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §5.2, §5.2.1 and §5.13
authority.finding: Decoded header field at 0x00 normally 0x70; unknown fields at 0x88,0x90,0x98 normally 0xf800,4,1. The specification describes normal values rather than mandatory invariants.

producer.source_revision: 16c2b236 (committed writer source at generation; later changes not included)
producer.result: Both fresh writer files report success; ODA File Converter 27.1.0 ACAD2007 DXF audit=1 returns process status zero but writes only Invalid input .err files, with no DXF. The audit result is determined from files, not process status.

positive_control.source: One LINE (1,2,3)→(4,5,6), authored from scratch using ezdxf 1.4.5 R2007; ODA 27.1.0 created AC1021 DWG, then the same ODA converter/target/audit setting emitted DXF with one LINE of matching endpoints and no .err.

comparison.independent_peer: LibreDWG 0.14 reads one LINE with the expected endpoints from baseline and each variant. Its Invalid num_pages 0 warning also occurs on the ODA-produced control, so it is not an observed discriminator.

variants.method: Require exact uncompressed 0x110 profile, matching primary/secondary encoded headers and repeated decoded block, and validate existing header/payload CRCs. Modify indicated little-endian header words only; recompute 0x108 header CRC and envelope compressed-data CRC, repeat the 304-byte block and RS-encode; replace both physical header copies. The random padding and rest of file remain unchanged. Original and all three mutated files reopen in LibreDWG with matching LINE endpoints.
variants.outcome: All three produce only ODA Invalid input .err, with no DXF, under the same audit conversion. This shows neither individual field change nor their combination is sufficient for this particular generated file; it does not prove their correctness, necessity or the rejection location.

reproduction: Build project and compile each tool using /usr/bin/g++ -std=c++17 -I. -Isrc -Isrc/intern <tool.cpp> build-gcc/libdxfrw.a -o <scratch-executable>.
Run line-producer <scratch>/plotstyle.dwg 1 and line-producer <scratch>/default.dwg 0. Run variant-tool <scratch>/plotstyle.dwg <scratch>/testN.dwg N for N=1,2,3.

Convert scratch generated files and positive control with ODAFileConverter <in-dir> <out-dir> ACAD2007 DXF 0 1 '*.dwg'. Inspect .err presence, output and actual entity semantics; exit code alone is insufficient.

Original physical scratch directory is /private/tmp/p6-ac1021-current. The in-tree producer and mutation tools generated byte-identical output to the recorded scratch tools for this source/build. Authored ezdxf file includes producer-generated metadata and its hash need not match when regenerated.
limits: The source LINE and output DXF/DWG are scratch-only; no fixture committed.
ODA error is generic. No causal claim or support promotion; real rejection may involve any other part of the file.
The two fields are normally-valued observations, not authorization to mutate production writer without stronger authority.
CRC checks use the current library primitives, not an independent CRC implementation; LibreDWG independent readback verifies a LINE but does not prove every header integrity property.
